name: uberllm
description: UberLLM MCP server (make images and videos, price requests, list models, read your balance) and a skill for setting up UberLLM's OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API.

api_key.title: UberLLM API key
api_key.description: Your ull_... key from https://uberllm.dev/dashboard/keys. The MCP server sends it as Authorization: Bearer. Leave empty to set it later with: claude plugin configure uberllm
